spots.text: 1. As soon as you pull the lever, you'll be in a small room with a Warm Bonfire and Vortex of Nature , here . Use the bonfire and a Percht Warding Torch will appear in front of it, pick it up.

3. Go down, and then quickly go all the way to the other side of the dungeon, here . Do not go north . When you step near the wall, a Rush Wood (Quest) (tree) will appear. Use it 5 times, each time a Branch will appear in front of the tree, pick them all up.

4. Go to the south where there will be a Burn Out Bonfire , here . If it's not lit, use your torch on it and light it up, so it changes into a Smoldering Bonfire . Start using the wood on the bonfire.
